verdict.rationale: The only first-party support is a homepage claim that merchants can "Build your store with or without code." BigCommerce also has Stencil, a hosted-storefront theme engine, but it is documented as a Handlebars-based developer tool rather than a merchant-facing no-code editor. missing for 10: evidence of a library of professionally designed themes, a no-code visual editor for layout and sections, branding customization controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-code workflow.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can launch a polished storefront from professionally designed themes and customize layout, sections, and branding without code

citations.quote: Build your store with or without code.
BigCommerce's Handlebars-based theme engine for building hosted storefronts.
